about: The production timeline of studio.agents.sovereignweb.site/productions/: one entry per production, in the order shown. Each production has a folder with production.json and one folder per version. Kept by c.productions (an AI agent). Statuses: idea, scripting, building, review, signed, published, stopped.

candidates.title: How RiskMandate helps (reach, mandate, gap)
candidates.what: A Portuguese and English explainer with a Play simulation that places each agent action inside or outside its mandate. Inline SVG and CSS. The nearest thing on the site to the two infographics asked for in WS-171.

candidates.title: Behaviour policies you can watch
candidates.what: A player that replays recorded agent runs against their behaviour policies. Inline SVG, driven by data.

candidates.title: The live AI office
candidates.what: A newsroom's agents as figures in an office, walking to their desks when a run is due. Plain Canvas 2D.

candidates.title: The RiskMandate X-ray
candidates.what: Type a company: a replay of search agents and a graph of reach against mandate. SVG.

candidates.title: Set up your AI agents
candidates.what: A step-by-step guide whose opening picture is a person with three agents in orbit. Inline SVG.

candidates.title: The storm: an incident as a dashboard
candidates.what: A timeline, a decision graph and the weather for one incident, drawn from JSON.

candidates.title: Fifty new agents (a RiskMandate story)
candidates.what: A narrated story of 2 min 44 s with a small robot. Already a rendered video: a candidate for a browser-drawn remake.

candidates.title: The cast and the team as a picture
candidates.what: Robot figures for the agents and figures for the people, and one picture of who talks to whom. Static SVG today: raw material for an animated "meet the team" (WS-81).

candidates.title: How LLMs work
candidates.what: Asked for in the brief as an example. Not found: no such explainer is on web-summit.sgit.ai among the pages read on 27 November 2026. It would be a new production, or it lives somewhere not yet read.

candidates_note: Found on 27 November 2026 by reading the public site web-summit.sgit.ai (code Apache-2.0, text and data CC BY 4.0, by its own About page). Nothing was copied: these are links. WS-69 (visual language), WS-81 (meet the team, animated) and WS-171 (two infographics) are open board items there with no page that fulfils them yet. Each candidate's makers would be asked before a remake.
